list.heading: Widgets
list.subtitle: The blocks around the content of the home page and What's new: where each goes, who sees it and in what order.

new.heading: New widget
new.subtitle: Choose what the widget shows, then where it goes and who sees it.

edit.heading: Widget
edit.subtitle: Its place, title, options and audience.

sort.heading: Sort widgets
sort.subtitle: Move a widget up or down within its position, then save. The pages draw them in this order.

forumStats.name: Forum statistics
forumStats.help: Tabs of the busiest threads and, if asked, the members with most messages.

rankedThreads.name: Thread list
rankedThreads.help: A short list of threads: latest posts, latest threads, most replied, most reacted or most viewed.

visitorCard.name: Visitor card
visitorCard.help: The member's own card: avatar, title, messages and reactions. Members only.

monthStandings.name: Members of the month
monthStandings.help: The top members of the month by points, with a picker for other months.

referralLink.name: Referral link
referralLink.help: The member's own invitation link, to copy and share. Members only.

topReferrers.name: Top referrers
topReferrers.help: The members who have brought in the most new members.

birthdays.name: Birthdays
birthdays.help: The members who have a birthday today.

suggestedMembers.name: Members to follow
suggestedMembers.help: A few active members the visitor does not follow yet.

forumLinks.name: Forums
forumLinks.help: A list of the forums, with a link to all of them.

recentlyActive.name: Recently active members
recentlyActive.help: The names of the members seen lately, with a total.

siteTotals.name: Site totals
siteTotals.help: The threads, messages and members of the site, and the newest member.

text.name: Text
text.help: A block of text you write yourself, in BB code.

limit.label: Rows
limit.help: How many rows each tab lists.

topPosters.label: Most messages
topPosters.switch: Show the members with most messages
topPosters.help: Adds a column with the members who wrote the most.

picker.label: Month picker
picker.switch: Let visitors look at another month
picker.help: Offers a year and a month under the list.

window.label: Seen within
window.help: How far back a member counts as recently active.

list.label: Widgets: {position}
list.emptyDescription: Nothing is drawn in these. Add the first widget.

steps.duplicateWarning: A copy with the same title, options and audience is added at the end of the position chosen.
steps.deleteWarning: Delete “{title}”? It stops showing at once and cannot be restored.

new.typeDescription: What the widget shows. You choose its place and audience next.

edit.typeNotShown: The site does not draw this type of widget yet. It is kept, and shows once the site can draw it.
edit.positionNotShown: The site does not draw this position yet. The widget is kept, and shows once the site can draw it.

form.positionHelp: Where it goes. To show a block in two places, duplicate it.
form.title: Title
form.titleHelp: Shown above the block. Leave it empty for the type's own title.
form.phonesHelp: Phones draw the sidebars below the content. Switch this off to leave the widget out there.

sort.none: No position has more than one widget to put in order.

notices.duplicated: Widget duplicated. This is the copy.

errors.id: That widget could not be found. Reload the page.
errors.order: The order must be a whole number.
errors.number: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
